college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: The Department of Sociology and Anthropology and the Department of Philosophy and Religion offer an interdisciplinary combined major in anthropology and religious studies. Students in the combined major integrate the study of culture and social structures with the study of religious traditions and praxis.
